fah-330.title: 3 Quick & Easy Recipes for Sudden Hunger
fah-330.culturalNotes: Serve these as quick lunch, dinner, or breakfast meals. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 2 days.

instructions.1: To make the tortilla pizza: cut the tortilla bread into pieces and place them in the air fryer.
instructions.2: Spread the cream cheese and mozzarella over the bread.
instructions.3: Spread ketchup and thyme over the bread, then add the pepperoni, peppers, and olives.
instructions.4: Cook the pizza in the air fryer for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: To make the hawawshi rolls: mix the ground meat with the minced onion, salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.6: Lay out the tortilla bread and add a layer of meat and cheese.
instructions.7: Roll up the bread and cut it into 2 cm pieces.
instructions.8: Arrange the pieces in the air fryer and cook for 20 minutes at 180°C.
instructions.9: To make the thyme bites: mix the flour, oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and milk.
instructions.10: Add the baking powder, thyme, olives, peppers, and cheese.
instructions.11: Pour the mixture into small molds and cook in the air fryer for 20 minutes at 160°C.

fah-331.title: 4 Different Dishes from Boiled Potatoes
fah-331.culturalNotes: Boiled potatoes can be stored in the fridge and used later to prepare these dishes quickly.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into small cubes.
instructions.3: To prepare the duqqa dish: mix the duqqa with oil and turmeric and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the duqqa mixture to the cubed potatoes and toss well.
instructions.5: Add the dill and parsley and mix.
instructions.6: To prepare the pickled potatoes: mix the cubed potatoes with the green and red peppers, vinegar, minced garlic, cumin, coriander, dill, salt, and pepper.
instructions.7: To prepare the casserole: mix the mashed potatoes with butter, salt, and pepper over heat, then add the cheese, tomatoes, and sliced peppers.
instructions.8: To prepare the potatoes with eggs: scramble the eggs in a pan with butter, then add the boiled or mashed potatoes and mix well.
instructions.9: Serve the dishes with dill and pepper to taste.

fah-332.title: 6 School Sandwich Ideas
fah-332.culturalNotes: Use any bread you like — baladi, shami, tortilla, or toast. Add favorite vegetables for extra nutrition.

instructions.1: Slice the potatoes, soak them in hot water for 5 minutes, then brown them in the oven or in oil.
instructions.2: In a bowl, mix a spoonful of cream cheese and spread it on the bread.
instructions.3: Add the roasted potato slices, Rumi cheese, and colored peppers.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mash the boiled egg and add a spoonful of cream cheese and the colored peppers. Mix well and spread on the bread.
instructions.5: Add the black olives and cabbage.
instructions.6: Cut the potatoes into small cubes and sauté them in oil until golden. Add the pastrami and colored peppers and stir.
instructions.7: Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted.
instructions.8: In a bowl, mix the egg with the diced potatoes, salt, pepper, and paprika. Stir well.
instructions.9: Add the grilled halloumi, mayonnaise, cucumber, pepper, pomegranate, and mint.
instructions.10: In a bowl, mix the cream cheese, Istanbuli cheese, diced peppers, and diced tomatoes. Stir well.
instructions.11: Add the lettuce, cucumber, and olives.

fah-333.title: Chicken Patties
fah-333.culturalNotes: The patties can be frozen after shaping: place them on foil or foam trays with a plastic bag between layers. Add other vegetables like carrots or zucchini for better flavor and color.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts and pat them dry well.
instructions.2: Mince the chicken breasts in a food processor until smooth.
instructions.3: Add the flour, mozzarella, eggs, colored peppers, parsley, onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt to the minced chicken.
instructions.4: Mix the ingredients well until combined.
instructions.5: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.6: Shape the mixture into patties of your preferred size.
instructions.7: Fry the patties until golden on both sides, covering the pan to ensure they cook through.
instructions.8: Serve the patties hot with ketchup, bread, mayonnaise, or cabbage as desired.

fah-334.title: Butter-Rolled Eggs (Bayd Madahrag)
fah-334.culturalNotes: Serve the butter-rolled eggs with yellow koshari and pickled tomatoes for a quick, tasty meal. They keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until fully hard-boiled.
instructions.2: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.3: Add the boiled eggs to the butter and roll them until coated.
instructions.4: Serve the butter-rolled eggs with yellow koshari and pickled tomatoes.

fah-335.title: Faux Cinnamon Rolls from Fino Bread
fah-335.culturalNotes: Use fino bread or homemade toast for the best result. Serve with ice cream for an even tastier treat.

instructions.1: Cut the fino bread or toast into thin slices.
instructions.2: Arrange the slices in a Pyrex baking dish.
instructions.3: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the vanilla, ground cinnamon, sugar, milk, and melted butter.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture over the sliced bread in the dish.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C.
instructions.6: Leave it in the oven until golden and the mixture sets (about 20 minutes).
instructions.7: Remove the dish from the oven and turn it out gently.
instructions.8: Dust the cinnamon rolls with powdered sugar.
instructions.9: Garnish with strawberries or any available fruit, nuts, or caramel as desired.
instructions.10: Serve hot or with ice cream.

fah-336.title: Shatita with Lentil Duqqa
fah-336.culturalNotes: Use any type of pepper you like, hot or sweet. Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat, add the minced onion, and sauté until golden.
instructions.2: Add the tomato juice and lentils, then let them simmer together, covered, over low heat.
instructions.3: In another pot, heat the oil and add the green and red peppers cut into medium strips; sauté until fragrant.
instructions.4: Add the minced garlic and stir with the peppers.
instructions.5: Add the cumin, black pepper, salt, and stock cube; stir together.
instructions.6: Add the diced tomatoes and let them simmer with the mixture.
instructions.7: Add half a cup of vinegar and let the mixture boil.
instructions.8: In a small pot, heat a tablespoon of ghee, add the minced garlic, and sauté until golden.
instructions.9: Add the dried coriander and stir well.
instructions.10: Add the tempering (tasha) to the lentil duqqa once fully cooked.
instructions.11: Serve the shatita with lentil duqqa hot, with bread.

fah-337.title: The Trendy Korean Bread
fah-337.culturalNotes: Use any cheese you like. Serve the Korean bread hot with tomato sauce or your favorite dip.

instructions.1: Mix the cream cheese with the milk in a bowl.
instructions.2: Transfer the mixture to a freezer bag and snip a small hole in the corner.
instructions.3: Take the Kaiser rolls and split them open in the middle.
instructions.4: Pipe the filling into the Kaiser rolls through the opening.
instructions.5: Arrange the rolls in an oiled baking tray.
instructions.6: Beat the butter with the minced tomatoes, parsley, and salt.
instructions.7: Spread the butter, tomato, and parsley mixture over the tops of the rolls.
instructions.8: Add mozzarella cheese on top of the rolls.
instructions.9: Bake on the highest heat under the broiler for 10 minutes until golden.

fah-338.title: Wonderful Negresco Pasta
fah-338.culturalNotes: Use leftover cooked chicken to make negresco, saving time and effort. Serve hot with a side salad.

instructions.1: Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee in a pan over heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces (raw or cooked) and sauté until golden.
instructions.3: Add the onion cut into wedges and sauté until softened.
instructions.4: Add the salt, pepper, sugar, paprika, and seven-spice; stir well.
instructions.5: Add the mushrooms (if available) and stir.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture to a side bowl and set aside.
instructions.7: In the same pan, add 2 tablespoons of ghee and 4 tablespoons of flour; stir until combined.
instructions.8: Add the cold milk gradually while stirring constantly until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.9: Add the salt, pepper, and 2 tablespoons of cream; stir well.
instructions.10: Add the half-cooked pasta and the chicken with mushrooms; stir well.
instructions.11: Pour the mixture into a casserole or Pyrex dish and spread the cheese on top.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven on the middle rack until golden.
instructions.13: Remove from the oven and serve hot.

fah-339.title: Homemade Indomie
fah-339.culturalNotes: Add more vegetables to taste for extra nutrition. Serve with a side salad for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the garlic and ginger and sauté until fragrant.
instructions.3: Add the chicken pieces and sauté until their moisture evaporates.
instructions.4: Add the onion and sauté until softened.
instructions.5: Add the carrots, colored peppers, cabbage, and mushrooms; stir well.
instructions.6: Add the chicken stock cube and tomato sauce; stir well.
instructions.7: Add the vinegar, hot sauce, and soy sauce; stir well.
instructions.8: Boil the pasta in boiling water for 3–4 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.9: Add some of the pasta cooking water to the mixture.
instructions.10: Add the pasta to the mixture and toss well.
instructions.11: Serve the homemade Indomie hot.

fah-340.title: Potato Burgers
fah-340.culturalNotes: Serve the burgers with a green salad or fries for a complete meal. They keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into small cubes.
instructions.2: Boil the potatoes in boiling water with a spoonful of salt for 5 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.3: Drain the boiled potatoes, add the Knorr potato seasoning, and mash well.
instructions.4: Add the chopped parsley, pastrami, egg, flour, and shredded cheese to the mixture and knead well.
instructions.5: Shape the mixture into patties of a suitable size.
instructions.6: Heat a pan over medium heat and add a little oil.
instructions.7: Fry the patties on both sides until golden.
instructions.8: Serve the burgers with mayonnaise and ketchup as desired.

fah-341.title: Potato Burger Sandwich
fah-341.culturalNotes: Use any cheese you prefer. You can also add onion slices or sweet peppers for flavor.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and mash them well while hot.
instructions.2: Add the chopped parsley, breadcrumbs, egg, salt, and pepper; knead together.
instructions.3: Pack the mixture into a potato press or use a large jar lid to shape the burgers.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over medium heat and add the oil.
instructions.5: Fry the burgers in the hot oil, turning until browned on both sides.
instructions.6: Add cheese slices on top of the burgers to melt.
instructions.7: Spread the buns with mayonnaise and ketchup.
instructions.8: Add the burger, tomatoes, and peppers to the bun and serve hot.

fah-342.title: Potatoes with Tahbisha Sauce
fah-342.culturalNotes: Serve this dish for breakfast, dinner, or lunch. Add some cooked fava beans for a more filling dish.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into small cubes, sprinkle with a little salt, and toss.
instructions.2: Fry the potatoes in plenty of oil over medium heat until crispy and golden.
instructions.3: Remove the potatoes from the oil and drain on paper towels.
instructions.4: Cut the red, green, and hot peppers (if desired) into small cubes.
instructions.5: Fry the peppers in the oil over medium heat until cooked, then remove and drain.
instructions.6: In the same pot, add one spoon of oil and a spoon of garlic; sauté until golden.
instructions.7: Add the diced tomatoes to the garlic and let them simmer briefly.
instructions.8: Add the cumin, black pepper, and paprika; stir well.
instructions.9: Add the vinegar to the mixture and let it boil.
instructions.10: Return the roasted peppers to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.11: Drain the fried potatoes and add them to the mixture; stir until the flavors combine.
instructions.12: Serve hot with baladi bread.

fah-343.title: Potatoes with Garlic Tasha
fah-343.culturalNotes: Serve as an appetizer or alongside breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Sprinkle grated cheese on top for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Heat a pan over heat and add a tablespoon of garlic.
instructions.2: Sauté the garlic until it turns golden.
instructions.3: Add the spices (cumin, coriander, chili) and stir with the garlic.
instructions.4: Add the bell pepper strips and stir with the mixture.
instructions.5: Add a small pinch of turmeric and a quarter cup of vinegar; stir together.
instructions.6: Add the boiled, mashed potatoes (½ kg) and mix well.
instructions.7: Season with salt and stir again.
instructions.8: Add the fresh coriander and chopped dill; mix well.
instructions.9: Serve hot.

fah-344.title: Oil-Free Roasted Potatoes
fah-344.culturalNotes: Serve as a snack or alongside main dishes. Add other spices to taste.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes well and peel them if you like.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes in half, then cut each half into three pieces.
instructions.3: Place a pot over heat, add the water and salt, then add the potatoes for exactly 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Drain the potatoes onto the baking tray.
instructions.5: Prepare the marinade by mixing the mayonnaise, mustard, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, chili, potato seasoning, starch, water, and oil.
instructions.6: Add the potatoes to the marinade and toss well.
instructions.7: Place the potatoes on a baking tray greased with oil or lined with parchment; spread them evenly.
instructions.8: Preheat the oven to its highest temperature, then place the tray on the middle rack.
instructions.9: Leave the potatoes in the oven until browned and crispy.
instructions.10: Serve hot with mayonnaise and ketchup if desired.

fah-345.title: Mozzarella Sticks & Onion Rings
fah-345.culturalNotes: Make sure the oil is very hot when frying the mozzarella to prevent the cheese from melting out. Serve with tomato sauce or your favorite dip.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into medium-thickness sticks.
instructions.2: Place the potatoes in a large bowl, add boiling water, and cover for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Cut the white onion into medium-thick rings.
instructions.4: Separate the rings from each other.
instructions.5: Drain the potatoes after soaking for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Season the potatoes and onion with salt and Knorr potato seasoning.
instructions.7: Prepare the egg wash with half a cup of milk, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.8: Prepare the coating from the ground breadcrumbs, starch, and Knorr Vegetar seasoning.
instructions.9: Dip the mozzarella sticks in the egg wash then the coating twice for full coverage.
instructions.10: Place the mozzarella in the freezer briefly.
instructions.11: Dip the onion rings in the egg wash then the coating twice.
instructions.12: Dip the potatoes in the egg wash then the coating twice.
instructions.13: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.14: Fry the onion rings until golden, then drain in a colander.
instructions.15: Fry the potatoes the same way, then drain in a colander.
instructions.16: Fry the mozzarella in very hot oil over high heat until golden.

fah-346.title: Half-Fried Potatoes for Freezing
fah-346.culturalNotes: Make sure the potato pieces are equal in size for even cooking. Half-fried potatoes keep in the freezer for a long time without spoiling.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into medium-thickness sticks, making sure the pieces are even.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.3: Add the potatoes to the hot oil without adding salt or any spices.
instructions.4: Fry the potatoes until pale blond; do not let them brown fully.
instructions.5: Spread the potatoes on a colander to drain the oil — do not use paper towels.
instructions.6: Let the potatoes cool completely.
instructions.7: Prepare a large tray and place a plastic bag on the bottom.
instructions.8: Place the cooled potatoes in the bag, arranging them so the pieces do not touch.
instructions.9: Repeat until all potato pieces are used, placing a layer of plastic between each layer of potatoes.
instructions.10: Place the tray in the freezer until the potatoes freeze.
instructions.11: Once frozen, pack the potatoes into freezer bags and remove the air before sealing.
instructions.12: Return the bags to the freezer.
instructions.13: When needed, take out the desired amount from the freezer and fry in hot oil until golden.
instructions.14: Serve the fried potatoes with spices to taste.

fah-347.title: Potatoes & Eggplant with Garlic and Vinegar
fah-347.culturalNotes: Serve as an appetizer at lunch or dinner, or as a breakfast dish with eggs, fava beans, or cheese.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into thin slices, then sticks, then small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the eggplant the same way.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan over heat.
instructions.4: Add the potatoes and eggplant and sauté until lightly golden.
instructions.5: Cover and leave for a minute or two until tender.
instructions.6: Add the garlic and salt, crushed together well.
instructions.7: Add the red pepper, green pepper, tomato, and cumin; stir briefly.
instructions.8: Add the vinegar and stir well.
instructions.9: Cover for one minute.
instructions.10: Chop the fresh coriander and sprinkle it over the dish while hot.

fah-348.title: Potato Banh (Battered Potato Slices)
fah-348.culturalNotes: Serve potato banh with pickles, boiled eggs, and bread. Suitable for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

instructions.1: Peel and wash the potatoes.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into thin slices.
instructions.3: Place the potatoes in boiling water with salt and cumin and leave until two-thirds cooked.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and leave until tender but not mushy.
instructions.5: In a bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, salt, pepper, cumin, seven-spice, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
instructions.6: Add water gradually until you have a medium-thick batter.
instructions.7: Dip the potato slices in the batter.
instructions.8: Fry the battered potato slices in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
instructions.9: Turn the potatoes to the other side until golden.
instructions.10: Cook the potatoes until they puff up and turn golden.
instructions.11: Spread the potatoes on absorbent paper to drain.

fah-349.title: Crispy Banh with Pasta in Tomato Sauce
fah-349.culturalNotes: Serve with a green salad or fresh bread. Sprinkle grated cheese on top for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare the banh marinade by mixing the large yogurt, half a cup of onion water, a teaspoon of black pepper, a pinch of cumin, and salt. Stir well.
instructions.2: Add a teaspoon of shatta paste if you want it spicy.
instructions.3: Add the well-drained banh to the marinade and mix well. Set aside for 2 hours.
instructions.4: In another pot, add a little oil and fry the onion, then add the garlic and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add half a kilo of minced tomatoes, the instant stock cube, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and 2 tablespoons of sauce; stir well.
instructions.6: Add the salt and a pinch of sugar, cover the pot, and let it thicken.
instructions.7: Add a large cup of boiling water and let it boil for 2 minutes.
instructions.8: Prepare the Vegetar mixture with the ground breadcrumbs and mix well.
instructions.9: Add the Vegetar mixture to the breadcrumbs and press down firmly by hand. Let it rest for half an hour.
instructions.10: Fry the coated banh in clean oil until golden.
instructions.11: Lift onto a colander and set on paper towels to drain.
instructions.12: Add a sprinkle of parsley to the crispy banh.
instructions.13: Half-boil the pasta, then add the spicy tomato sauce.
instructions.14: Stir the pasta well, then add a spoonful of country ghee.
instructions.15: Add half a cup of the pasta cooking water, cover, and let it finish cooking.
instructions.16: Serve the crispy banh with the pasta in tomato sauce.

fah-350.title: Crispy Popcorn Chicken
fah-350.culturalNotes: Serve the popcorn chicken with fries or in tasty sandwiches. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts and cut them into small cubes.
instructions.2: Pat the cubes dry well with a paper towel.
instructions.3: Prepare the marinade by mixing the yogurt, ketchup, starch, baking powder, mustard, seven-spice, onion powder, garlic powder, thyme, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
instructions.4: Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and toss until fully coated.
instructions.5: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
instructions.6: Prepare the coating by mixing the starch, flour, and crispy breadcrumbs in another bowl.
instructions.7: Remove the chicken from the fridge and toss in the coating until fully covered.
instructions.8: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Fry the chicken pieces until golden.
instructions.10: Place the fried chicken on a paper towel to absorb excess oil.
instructions.11: Serve the popcorn chicken with different sauces like cocktail, mayonnaise, ketchup, or barbecue as desired.

fah-351.title: Quick Rescue Pizza
fah-351.culturalNotes: Add any other ingredients like mushrooms or olives as desired. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Add a drop of oil to the pan and spread it over heat.
instructions.2: Place the tortilla in the pan and leave until browned on one side.
instructions.3: Add the second tortilla and flip.
instructions.4: Add the Rumi cheese or any available cheese.
instructions.5: Add the ketchup and thyme.
instructions.6: You can add pastrami and peppers as desired.
instructions.7: Cover the pan for a few minutes until the cheese melts.
instructions.8: Serve hot with ketchup and ranch sauce.

fah-352.title: Flourless Pan Potato Pizza
fah-352.culturalNotes: Add any other ingredients like sweet peppers or mushrooms as desired. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Place the cube of butter in the pan over heat.
instructions.2: Add the potatoes cut into very small pieces.
instructions.3: Cover the potatoes and leave until tender.
instructions.4: Slice the onion very thinly.
instructions.5: Add the onion to the potatoes and keep stirring.
instructions.6: Cover and leave over low heat until cooked and browned.
instructions.7: Add the black pepper, paprika, and salt; stir well.
instructions.8: Level the mixture in the pan and add the mozzarella and Rumi or cheddar cheese.
instructions.9: Cover the pan and leave until the cheese melts.
instructions.10: Serve with ketchup and basil.
instructions.11: Serve hot for breakfast or dinner.

fah-353.title: Crepe Pizza with Chicken Popcorn
fah-353.culturalNotes: Serve crepe pizza with a green salad or fries. Use other cheeses as desired.

instructions.1: To prepare the popcorn chicken:
instructions.2: Wash and dry the chicken breasts and cut them into cubes.
instructions.3: Mix the yogurt with the ketchup, hot sauce, and spices.
instructions.4: Soak the chicken pieces in the mixture for one hour.
instructions.5: Mix the flour, starch, and crispy coating in a plastic bag.
instructions.6: Coat the chicken pieces in the marinade, then in the dry mixture.
instructions.7: Fry the chicken pieces in hot oil until golden.
instructions.8: To prepare the crepe pizza:
instructions.9: Make the pizza sauce from ketchup, tomato sauce, onion powder, garlic powder, thyme, and salt.
instructions.10: Heat a little oil in a pan and place a crepe sheet in it.
instructions.11: Spread the pizza sauce on the crepe, then add the cheese mixture, popcorn chicken, peppers, tomatoes, olives, and sausage.
instructions.12: Cover with another crepe and brush with oil.
instructions.13: Fry the pizza until golden on both sides.
instructions.14: Cut the pizza and serve hot.

fah-354.title: Yeast-Free Pizza
fah-354.culturalNotes: Use any flour — bread flour or all-purpose. Yogurt can replace the buttermilk. The dough keeps in the fridge for one day.

ingredients.fah-354-i14: Toppings of choice (tomatoes, olives, peppers, pastrami)

instructions.1: Blend the flour, buttermilk, oil, eggs, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a blender until smooth.
instructions.2: If the mixture is too thick, add a little milk or water.
instructions.3: Cover the batter and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: First cooking method (oven):
instructions.5: Grease a tray with oil, pour in the batter, and spread it evenly.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 7–8 minutes until light golden.
instructions.7: Second cooking method (stovetop):
instructions.8: Grease a pan with oil, add some batter, and spread it to a ½ cm thickness.
instructions.9: Place the pan over low heat and cover for 5 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.10: To prepare the pizza sauce:
instructions.11: Mix 3 tablespoons of tomato sauce (ketchup) with a pinch of thyme, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
instructions.12: To finish the pizza:
instructions.13: Spread the sauce over the cooked base and distribute the cheese and toppings as desired.
instructions.14: Return the pizza to the oven for a minute or until the cheese melts.
instructions.15: Cut the pizza and serve hot.

fah-355.title: No-Knead Pizza on Toast
fah-355.culturalNotes: Change the toppings to taste — other meats or vegetables. The pizza keeps in the fridge for 2 days or can be frozen longer.

instructions.1: Cut the bell peppers and tomatoes into small cubes.
instructions.2: Slice the onion thinly and separate the pieces so they don't clump.
instructions.3: Slice the black olives.
instructions.4: Cut the sausage into small pieces.
instructions.5: Prepare the sauce: mix 2 tablespoons of tomato sauce and 2 tablespoons of ketchup with the onion powder, garlic powder, and oregano. Mix well.
instructions.6: Grease a baking tray with oil.
instructions.7: Arrange the toast slices in the tray, pressing them together to form one layer.
instructions.8: Spread the sauce over the toast slices.
instructions.9: Mix the yogurt with the mozzarella and stir well — the yogurt keeps the cheese soft.
instructions.10: Spread the cheese mixture over the sauce.
instructions.11: Distribute the peppers, tomatoes, sausage, olives, and onion over the cheese.
instructions.12: Lay the Rumi cheese slices on top.
instructions.13: Preheat the oven to its highest temperature and place the tray on the middle rack.
instructions.14: Bake the pizza for 10 minutes until the cheese melts and turns golden.

fah-356.title: Stuffed Eggplant with Ramadan Pickle Filling
fah-356.culturalNotes: The filling mixture can also be used to pickle fava beans and other vegetables. It's preserved with salt and vinegar and needs no refrigeration.

instructions.1: Choose medium eggplants and remove the green stems.
instructions.2: Make small slits in the eggplants with a knife.
instructions.3: Place the eggplants in a pot and cover with boiling water.
instructions.4: Add half a cup of white vinegar and 2 teaspoons of salt.
instructions.5: Leave the eggplants over heat for 10–12 minutes until tender.
instructions.6: In another bowl, combine half a kilo of peppers (hot, mild, and red), half a cup of lemon juice, a large head of garlic, a tablespoon of coriander, and a tablespoon of cumin.
instructions.7: Blend the ingredients until well combined.
instructions.8: Drain the eggplants in a colander and let them cool slightly.
instructions.9: Mix the grated carrot and chopped parsley with 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.10: Add 2 tablespoons of the pickle filling to the carrot and parsley mixture.
instructions.11: Open a slit in each eggplant and stuff it with the mixture.
instructions.12: Pack the stuffed eggplants into jars and store in the fridge.

fah-357.title: Eid Snacks: Roasted Fava Beans, Lupin Beans & Chickpeas
fah-357.culturalNotes: Never use a wet spoon or your hands when taking snacks from the container — this keeps them fresh longer.

instructions.1: Soak the lupin beans and chickpeas in boiling water for 3 hours.
instructions.2: Drain the lupin beans and chickpeas and wash them well.
instructions.3: Boil the lupin beans and chickpeas in boiling water for 1 to 1¼ hours, then check the beans for doneness.
instructions.4: Toast the fava beans over medium heat until golden.
instructions.5: Drain and wash the fava beans, then add them to the boiling water with the salt.
instructions.6: Prepare the duqqa by mixing the water, salt, cumin, paprika, chili, and lemon juice (adding harissa if available).
instructions.7: Add the lupin beans, chickpeas, and fava beans to the duqqa and cover them well.
instructions.8: Leave them in the duqqa for 2–3 hours.
instructions.9: Store the snacks in sealed, covered containers in the fridge, using a clean, dry spoon each time.

fah-358.title: Chicken Rolls
fah-358.culturalNotes: Add a hot pepper if you like it spicy. Serve the chicken rolls with tomato sauce or mayonnaise.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small pieces.
instructions.2: Mix the chicken with salt, pepper, thyme, seven-spice, chicken seasoning, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, a pinch of sugar, and a spoonful of ketchup or hot sauce.
instructions.3: Stir the mixture well and set aside.
instructions.4: Cut the onion and colored peppers into small pieces.
instructions.5: Heat the oil in a pan and sauté the chicken until browned on all sides.
instructions.6: Add the onion and peppers to the chicken and cook together until done.
instructions.7: Grease the baking sheet with oil.
instructions.8: Cut the Syrian bread or soft roqaq into squares.
instructions.9: Place two squares on top of each other and fill them with the mixture.
instructions.10: Roll them up and arrange in the tray.
instructions.11: Top the rolls with mozzarella slices, tomatoes, peppers, and olives as desired.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 20 minutes.

fah-359.title: Parmeli Cheese Dip with Roasted Potatoes
fah-359.culturalNotes: This dip also works in school lunchboxes. It keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes well, cut them in half, then cut each half into three pieces.
instructions.2: Bring water to a boil in a pot, add a pinch of salt, add the potatoes, and boil for 7 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the potatoes from the water and place them on a tray greased with oil or lined with parchment.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the potatoes with pepper, paprika, and thyme.
instructions.5: Bake at the highest temperature until the potatoes brown.
instructions.6: Meanwhile, prepare the dip: mix the Parmeli cheese, yogurt, thyme, and olive oil well.
instructions.7: Serve the roasted potatoes with the delicious dip.

fah-360.title: Butter & Garlic Tortilla
fah-360.culturalNotes: Substitute pastrami for the cheese if available. Perfect for a quick, tasty breakfast or a light meal.

instructions.1: Heat a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add a spoonful of butter to the pan and let it melt.
instructions.3: Add the garlic cloves and stir until golden.
instructions.4: Add a pinch of salt, black pepper, and chili (to taste); stir together.
instructions.5: Add the chopped parsley and stir for a minute.
instructions.6: Remove the garlic and parsley mixture from the pan and set aside.
instructions.7: In the same pan, add another spoonful of butter and let it melt.
instructions.8: Place a tortilla in the pan and brush one side with butter.
instructions.9: Press the tortilla with a spoon or spatula until golden.
instructions.10: Flip the tortilla and butter the other side.
instructions.11: Add the garlic-parsley mixture to one half of the tortilla, then place a piece of cheese (to taste) on the other half.
instructions.12: Fold the tortilla into a triangle or half-moon and leave until golden on both sides.
instructions.13: Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
instructions.14: Serve the tortillas hot.

fah-361.title: Healthy Whole-Grain Toast
fah-361.culturalNotes: The toast can be frozen and used as needed. Fill it with smoked chicken or any other filling you like.

instructions.1: Choose finely milled whole-grain flour.
instructions.2: Mix 1.5 kg of whole-grain flour with 5 cups of warm water and let the mixture rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.3: In a small bowl, mix 2 tablespoons of flour with half a cup of water and stir over heat until it reaches a pudding-like consistency. Remove from heat and let cool.
instructions.4: Add the yeast, salt, honey, baking powder, and oil to the flour and knead the mixture for 15 minutes.
instructions.5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into pieces of about 50 g each, roll each piece flat, and shape into rolls.
instructions.7: Place the rolls in an oiled tray and let them rise again for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: Prepare a water-sugar mixture (1 cup water and 2 tablespoons sugar) and sprinkle it over the bread.
instructions.9: Sprinkle the seeds over the bread and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Let the toast cool completely before slicing and storing in the freezer.

fah-362.title: Quick & Healthy Granola
fah-362.culturalNotes: Enjoy the granola as a snack or add it to your favorite fruits for a healthy, filling dinner.

instructions.1: Mix the oats, toasted sesame seeds, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, chia seeds, honey, and coconut oil in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the nuts to taste.
instructions.3: Knead the ingredients by hand until combined.
instructions.4: Spread the mixture on a baking tray.
instructions.5: Place the tray in a preheated oven at 170°C.
instructions.6: Stir the mixture occasionally until toasted and light golden.
instructions.7: Add the golden and black raisins after removing the mixture from the oven.
instructions.8: Mix well until combined.
instructions.9: Let the granola cool, then pack it into airtight containers.

fah-363.title: Budget Hawawshi with a Dreamy Filling
fah-363.culturalNotes: Add any other cheese or vegetables to taste. The hawawshi keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours before cooking.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the flour and baking powder and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the warm water gradually and knead until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Add a little oil and knead the dough again.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into 8 equal balls.
instructions.6: Flatten each ball using a fork or a dough press.
instructions.7: Add the filling (cumin, paprika, coriander, mozzarella, green onion, parsley, pepper, potato, black pepper) to the center of each piece of dough.
instructions.8: Wrap the filling with the dough and seal the hawawshi well.
instructions.9: Grease a baking tray with oil and arrange the hawawshi in it.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes or until golden.

fah-364.title: Meatless Potato Hawawshi
fah-364.culturalNotes: Serve the hawawshi for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. It keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the baking powder, salt, and sugar.
instructions.2: Add the warm water gradually and knead the dough for 3 minutes.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons of oil and knead again for 3–4 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut the dough into 8 equal balls and dust them with flour.
instructions.5: Cover the balls with plastic and a clean towel and let them rest.
instructions.6: Boil the potatoes; chop the green onion and parsley finely.
instructions.7: Add the mozzarella, black pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika, and hot pepper or shatta to the boiled potatoes and mash everything well.
instructions.8: Take a ball of dough, dust it with flour, and roll it out thin.
instructions.9: Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of the dough, close it, then flatten it again.
instructions.10: Heat a pan, add a spoonful of oil, place the hawawshi, and cover.
instructions.11: Flip the hawawshi until golden on both sides.
instructions.12: Serve the hawawshi with chopped parsley and pickles.

fah-365.title: Egg Hawawshi
fah-365.culturalNotes: Add any other ingredients like sausage or pastrami to taste. Serve hot with a light salad or juice.

instructions.1: Beat the egg with the black pepper.
instructions.2: Add the green onion, peppers, tomatoes, and green pepper to the egg and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the diced cheese and mix together.
instructions.4: Open the baladi bread with scissors and place the filling in the center of each piece.
instructions.5: Close the baladi bread into a hawawshi shape.
instructions.6: Heat a pan over heat and add the butter, oil, and ghee.
instructions.7: Place the hawawshi in the pan and cover.
instructions.8: Flip the hawawshi once golden on the first side.
instructions.9: Cover again until golden on the other side.
instructions.10: Cook until the hawawshi is crispy outside and the filling is cooked through.

fah-366.title: One-Pot Chicken Drumsticks with Rice
fah-366.culturalNotes: Serve with a yogurt salad made of 3 cups yogurt, 2 diced cucumbers, 2 tablespoons mayonnaise, a pinch of salt, and lemon juice.

instructions.1: Heat a pot over heat and add 2 tablespoons of oil and a spoonful of ghee.
instructions.2: Add a pinch of salt, then add the drumsticks and brown them until golden.
instructions.3: Add the whole spices (black pepper, cardamom, bay leaves, cinnamon, cloves) and stir.
instructions.4: Add the minced onion and hot peppers and sauté well.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and stir.
instructions.6: Add the raisins and stir.
instructions.7: Add the chopped tomatoes and stir.
instructions.8: Wash the rice, soak it for half an hour, then add it to the pot with the grated carrots and stir.
instructions.9: Add the boiling water or broth and adjust the salt.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and let the rice boil and absorb the liquid.
instructions.11: After boiling, add the remaining water over the pot to prevent sticking.
instructions.12: Cover the pot, lower the heat, and let the rice cook through completely.
instructions.13: Keep the pot over low heat, covered, for 5 minutes to give the rice a wonderful flavor.

fah-367.title: Homemade Doner Kebab
fah-367.culturalNotes: Serve the doner kebab with sauced pasta for a complete lunch. Squeeze lemon over the sandwich when serving for extra freshness.

instructions.1: Prepare the marinade: mix the onion, yogurt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, cumin, chili, black pepper, coriander, vinegar, olive oil, and garlic in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the ground meat mixed with fat to the marinade and knead well.
instructions.3: Spread the mixture thinly on parchment paper, then roll it up.
instructions.4: Place the rolls in an oiled tray and repeat until all the mixture is used.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat (200°C) on the lowest rack for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Prepare the salsa: chop the tomatoes, coriander, parsley, hot peppers, and red onion. Mix with black pepper, cumin, coriander, and salt.
instructions.7: Add the tomatoes and parsley to the salsa and mix well.
instructions.8: Squeeze lemon over the salsa and serve.
instructions.9: Prepare the tahini sauce: mix the tahini, yogurt, mayonnaise, water, vinegar, and salt until you get a medium consistency.
instructions.10: When the cooking time ends, remove the rolls from the oven and flip them to cook the other side.
instructions.11: Slice the rolls thinly and serve with the flatbread, salsa, tahini sauce, and pickles.

fah-368.title: Rizo Rice with Chicken Strips
fah-368.culturalNotes: The flour-and-starch-coated chicken can be frozen for later use. Serve the meal with a green salad or another side dish.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts, clean them well, and drain the water.
instructions.2: Cut the breasts into thin strips (fingers).
instructions.3: Mix the chicken with the spices: salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, chicken seasoning, thyme, cardamom powder, sugar, and ketchup or hot sauce.
instructions.4: Refrigerate the mixture for 2 hours.
instructions.5: Prepare the coating: mix the flour, starch, baking powder, salt, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, chicken seasoning, and half a cup of water until the consistency is like pancake batter.
instructions.6: Coat the chicken in the batter, then in the flour and starch mixture, and set on a side plate.
instructions.7: Refrigerate the chicken for 1 hour.
instructions.8: Prepare the rice: wash and drain the rice, then heat oil and ghee in a pot and add the chopped onion, salt, pepper, molasses, soy sauce, curry, turmeric, paprika, and spices; stir until fragrant.
instructions.9: Add the rice and stir well, then add water (1¼ cups per cup of rice) and let it heat through.
instructions.10: Add the stock cube and let the rice absorb the water and cook.
instructions.11: Prepare the sauce: mix the ketchup, mustard, molasses, and chili sauce.
instructions.12: Fry the chicken in a pan over medium heat until golden.
instructions.13: Serve the chicken strips with the rizo rice and sauce.

fah-369.title: Stuffed Roqaq Pockets
fah-369.culturalNotes: Make sure to wrap the roqaq tightly so the filling doesn't escape. Serve with a side salad or bread.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pan and add the minced white onion; sauté until caramelized.
instructions.2: Add the bay leaves, black pepper, sugar, and spices; stir well.
instructions.3: Add the ground meat and stir until browned and crumbly.
instructions.4: Add the salt and stir once more.
instructions.5: Prepare the soft roqaq: butter each sheet and fold it in thirds.
instructions.6: Add the filling (browned meat) and seal the edges on all sides.
instructions.7: Butter the roqaq again and fold it closed.
instructions.8: Place the roqaq in a buttered tray.
instructions.9: Bake in a very hot oven for 5 minutes until the roqaq browns and turns golden.
instructions.10: Prepare the broth by boiling half a cup of broth and half a cup of milk, seasoned with salt and pepper.
instructions.11: Pour the broth over the roqaq in the oven and brush the top with butter.
instructions.12: Return the roqaq to the oven for 5 more minutes.
instructions.13: Remove from the oven and garnish with parsley and dill.
instructions.14: Serve the roqaq hot.

fah-370.title: Syrian Potato Sandwich
fah-370.culturalNotes: The garlic sauce (toum) keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve the sandwich with ketchup and jalapeños to taste.

instructions.1: Place the flour in a stand mixer — or knead by hand if you don't have one.
instructions.2: Add the salt, yeast, sugar, and baking powder to the flour and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the warm water gradually to the flour while kneading until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Add 3 tablespoons of oil to the dough and knead for 2 minutes.
instructions.5: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Prepare the toum (garlic sauce): mix the sliced garlic, starch, salt, sugar, and water in a bowl.
instructions.7: Cook the mixture over heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
instructions.8: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, and vinegar to the thickened mixture and mix well.
instructions.9: Add half a cup of oil to the mixture and mix well.
instructions.10: Let the toum cool, then transfer to a bowl.
instructions.11: Take the risen dough and flatten it on a tray or work surface.
instructions.12: Ball up the dough and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.13: Roll the dough out well until almost translucent.
instructions.14: Bake the dough on a hot griddle until it puffs up and turns golden.
instructions.15: Wrap the hot bread in a towel to keep it soft.
instructions.16: Prepare the filling: slice the potatoes, pickles, and jalapeños.
instructions.17: Take the bread, spread the toum on it, then add the potatoes, pickles, jalapeños, and cheese.
instructions.19: Place the sandwich on a hot grill with a little oil.
instructions.20: Turn the sandwich until golden on both sides.

fah-371.title: The Fatty Sandwich (Mixed Offal Platter)
fah-371.culturalNotes: Adjust the quantities to taste and add more spices as you like. The offal keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

ingredients.fah-371-i21: Duqqa mix (salt, cumin, coriander, pepper, chili)

instructions.1: Wash the spleen and lungs well, soak them briefly in vinegar water, then rinse and drain.
instructions.2: Place the spleen and lungs in boiling water with the garlic, carrot, onion, tomato, bay leaves, cardamom, mastic, sugar, salt, and black pepper. Cover the pot, bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce and simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
instructions.3: Boil the head meat, drain it, and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.4: Prepare the kofta from half a kilo of ground meat, salt, and pepper; shape into small balls and refrigerate.
instructions.5: Slice the heart, kidneys, and liver thinly.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a tray and render the lamb fat until it melts, then remove it from the tray.
instructions.7: Add the heart and kidneys and sauté until browned, then set aside.
instructions.8: Add the onion, sauté briefly, then set aside.
instructions.9: Add the liver and garlic and sauté until the liver browns, then set aside.
instructions.10: Add the kofta and sauté until browned, then set aside.
instructions.11: Return all the ingredients to the tray and add the hot and sweet peppers, salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander. Stir everything over heat until the flavors meld.
instructions.12: Prepare a tray lined with arugula and pile all the cooked ingredients on it.
instructions.13: Serve the offal platter with hot baladi bread, pickles, and tahini sauce. You can also add the duqqa made of salt, cumin, coriander, pepper, and chili.
instructions.14: Serve hot and enjoy the amazing flavor.

fah-372.title: Sausage Sandwiches
fah-372.culturalNotes: Use homemade or store-bought sausage. Garnish with French lettuce or cabbage.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the milk powder, oil, warm water, and egg whites; mix well.
instructions.3: Add the sifted flour, baking powder, and vinegar; mix until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
instructions.5: Add the melted butter and mix for 2 more minutes.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into small pieces, weighing 25–30 g each.
instructions.8: Shape each piece into a ball and place on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Cover the dough and let it rise for another 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the bread with egg white beaten with milk and vanilla.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 15–20 minutes.
instructions.12: Prepare the filling: cut the peppers, onion, and sausage and fry them together.
instructions.13: Add the ketchup and hot sauce and mix well.
instructions.14: Stuff the bread with the filling and serve hot.

fah-373.title: Grilled Chicken Sandwich
fah-373.culturalNotes: Use potatoes alone if you don't want to add chicken. Serve the sandwich with tahini sauce for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the grill seasoning, salt, lemon juice, vinegar, buttermilk, barbecue sauce, hot sauce, and honey in a bowl.
instructions.2: Cut the chicken into small cubes and place them in the marinade. Mix well and leave for a few minutes.
instructions.3: Cut the potatoes into small cubes and place in a bowl. Add salt and toss well.
instructions.4: Fry the potatoes in a pan with a little oil until golden.
instructions.5: Grill the chicken in a hot pan or in the oven until cooked.
instructions.6: Mix the onion, salt, lemon juice, ketchup, hot sauce, parsley, and coriander in a bowl.
instructions.7: Drain the fried potatoes in a colander.
instructions.8: Place the grilled chicken, fried potatoes, and the mixture on a serving plate.
instructions.9: Stuff the shami bread with the chicken, potatoes, and mixture. Sprinkle parsley on top.
instructions.10: Close the sandwich from the sides and roll it up.
instructions.11: Toast the sandwich in a sandwich maker or on a griddle until golden and crispy.

fah-374.title: Waffle Toast Sandwich
fah-374.culturalNotes: Use any cheese or deli meat you prefer. Add vegetables like tomatoes or parsley for more variety.

instructions.1: Heat the waffle iron and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.2: Place a slice of toast in the waffle iron.
instructions.3: Spread the sandwich with cream cheese.
instructions.4: Add any other ingredients like Rumi, cheddar, or turkey pastrami as desired.
instructions.5: Place another slice of toast over the ingredients.
instructions.6: Spread the top slice of toast with cream cheese.
instructions.7: Close the waffle iron and leave until the sandwich is toasted.
instructions.8: Remove the sandwich from the iron and serve hot with your favorite drink.

fah-375.title: Smoked Chicken Sandwiches
fah-375.culturalNotes: The sandwiches can be frozen and used as needed. Serve them hot or cold.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into thin strips.
instructions.2: Season the chicken with salt, paprika, chicken seasoning, black pepper, thyme, garlic powder, and onion powder.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of olive oil and a quarter cup of barbecue sauce; toss the chicken well.
instructions.4: Let the chicken absorb the marinade for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Bake the chicken at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.6: Prepare the sauce by mixing a cup of mayonnaise, a quarter cup of barbecue sauce, a quarter cup of hot sauce, and a tablespoon of white honey.
instructions.7: Stir the sauce well until smooth.
instructions.8: Cut the small Syrian bread in half.
instructions.9: Place a spoonful of sauce on the bread.
instructions.10: Add the smoked chicken slices, fried potatoes, and pickles.
instructions.11: Roll the sandwich carefully.
instructions.12: Bake the sandwich for 5 minutes until golden.

fah-376.title: Mini Burger Sandwiches
fah-376.culturalNotes: Use different cheeses and vegetables to taste. The burgers keep in the fridge for 2 days before use.

ingredients.fah-376-i9: Bread dough (flour, yeast, sugar, salt, warm milk, yogurt)

instructions.1: Mix the meat with the breadcrumbs, sugar, salt, and pepper well.
instructions.2: Shape the burger into small balls and press them flat.
instructions.3: Grill the burgers on a griddle until cooked on both sides.
instructions.4: Prepare the dough from the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, milk, and yogurt; let it rise.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small balls and flatten them.
instructions.6: Stuff the dough with cheese, pickles, and burger; seal them closed.
instructions.7: Grill the sandwiches on a griddle until the bread is cooked and golden.

fah-377.title: Syrian Potato Sandwiches with Garlic Sauce
fah-377.culturalNotes: The toum (garlic sauce) keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve the sandwiches with a light salad or tomato slices.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and wash them well.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into long, thin strips.
instructions.3: Add a pinch of salt to the potatoes and toss well.
instructions.4: Fry the potatoes in plenty of oil until crispy and golden.
instructions.5: In a bowl, mix a cup of water with 3 level tablespoons of starch and 6 garlic cloves.
instructions.6: Stir the ingredients well until the starch turns translucent.
instructions.7: Add a cup of yogurt, a teaspoon of sugar, a teaspoon of salt, and a quarter cup of oil.
instructions.8: Blend the ingredients until you get a toum consistency.
instructions.9: Drain the fried potatoes and let them cool slightly.
instructions.10: Take the shami bread and add a tablespoon of toum to each piece.
instructions.11: Add the fried potatoes, pickles, and ketchup.
instructions.12: Cheese can be added if available.
instructions.13: Roll the sandwiches tightly and brush them with oil.
instructions.14: Grill the sandwiches until golden and crispy.
instructions.15: Let the sandwiches cool slightly, then cut and serve hot.

fah-378.title: Cheese, Pepper & Luncheon Sandwiches
fah-378.culturalNotes: Add browned ground meat or any other filling to taste. Works for breakfast, lunch, or even a midnight snack.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, water, vinegar, baking powder, sugar, salt, and oil in a bowl until the batter is smooth.
instructions.2: Dice the cheese, peppers, luncheon, and olives and mix them together.
instructions.3: Heat a griddle over heat and grease it with a little oil.
instructions.4: Pour a ladleful of batter onto the griddle and leave until golden.
instructions.5: Flip the batter to the other side until golden as well.
instructions.6: Place the filling on half the disc and fold it in half.
instructions.7: Brush the sandwich with oil or ghee and leave until browned on the other side.
instructions.8: Flip the sandwich until it colors nicely and the cheese melts.

fah-379.title: Shawarma & Pastrami Cheese Sandwiches
fah-379.culturalNotes: Don't soak the toast slices in milk too long or they'll get soggy. Serve with a light salad or fries.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to high heat.
instructions.2: Grease a baking tray with olive oil.
instructions.3: Dip the toast slices in the milk.
instructions.4: Place a slice of cheese on each milk-dipped toast slice.
instructions.5: Add a slice of shawarma and pastrami over the cheese.
instructions.6: Arrange the sandwiches in the tray.
instructions.7: Sprinkle instant stock over the sandwiches to taste.
instructions.8: Bake until golden.
instructions.9: Serve the sandwiches hot.

fah-380.title: 10-Minute Sandwiches — No Yeast, No Oven
fah-380.culturalNotes: Change the fillings to taste — luncheon, green pepper, shredded cheese, olives, cardamom. The sandwiches keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and vinegar and mix well.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into balls the size of a large lemon.
instructions.6: Flatten each ball and place the filling in the center.
instructions.7: Seal the sandwiches well and shape them.
instructions.8: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Fry the sandwiches until browned on both sides.
instructions.10: Serve them hot.

fah-381.title: Stuffed Pastry Sandwiches
fah-381.culturalNotes: The sandwiches keep in the fridge; reheat before serving. Use any fridge leftovers as fillings.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water gradually and knead until you get a soft, pliable dough.
instructions.3: Cover the dough with a clean towel and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut the dough into small egg-sized balls.
instructions.5: Roll out each ball with a little flour until thin.
instructions.6: Add your favorite fillings (cheese, pastrami, peppers, olives, parsley, figs, seasoned meat, boiled chicken, eggs) in the center of the dough.
instructions.7: Seal the edges well and shape into sandwiches.
instructions.8: Heat a pan over medium-low heat and add a couple drops of oil.
instructions.9: Place the sandwiches in the pan and turn until golden on all sides.
instructions.10: Serve hot with milk tea or mint tea.

fah-382.title: School Sandwiches with Fluffy Dough
fah-382.culturalNotes: The sandwiches can be frozen after cooling — pack them in bags. Take out what you need a day ahead to return to room temperature.

instructions.1: Mix the dry ingredients (flour, milk powder, sugar, yeast, salt, baking powder) in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water, sugar, salt, and baking powder; stir well.
instructions.3: Add the butter or oil and mix until combined.
instructions.4: Add the yogurt or buttermilk or regular milk with the vinegar and knead the dough.
instructions.5: Add water gradually until the dough forms, then knead for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel and leave it in a warm place until doubled.
instructions.7: Shape the dough into small balls the size of a large lemon and cover for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll out each ball and fill with your favorite fillings (mozzarella, cheddar, pastrami).
instructions.9: Seal the sandwiches well.
instructions.10: Brush the sandwiches with the mixture of flour, pomegranate molasses, and water.
instructions.11: Coat the sandwiches with toasted sesame.
instructions.12: Arrange the sandwiches on an oiled or parchment-lined tray, leaving space between them.
instructions.13: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.14: Let the sandwiches cool before storing in the freezer.

fah-383.title: Restaurant-Style Sandwiches at Home
fah-383.culturalNotes: Make sure to chill the potatoes and coleslaw in the fridge before serving to keep them crunchy. Add cheese sauce if you like.

instructions.1: Mix 4 cups of flour with the black pepper, smoked paprika, instant stock, chicken seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder, ginger, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Whisk half the seasoned flour with the eggs, buttermilk, baking powder, and harissa until the consistency resembles pancake batter.
instructions.3: Wash and dry the chicken breasts, cut them into thick pieces, season with the dry mix, and refrigerate, covered.
instructions.4: In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, chopped dill, onion powder, garlic powder, ginger, and black pepper; add the mustard and stir well.
instructions.5: Peel the potatoes, cut into thin slices, place in a deep bowl, add the vinegar, salt, and boiling water, and let them cool.
instructions.6: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the potatoes until crispy.
instructions.7: Slice the cabbage thinly into a bowl, then add the grated carrots, mayonnaise, yogurt, honey, vinegar, orange juice, and salt; mix well.
instructions.8: Coat the marinated chicken in the wet batter, then in the dry mix, and fry in the oil until golden.
instructions.9: Serve the sandwiches with coleslaw, crispy chicken, crispy potatoes, ranch sauce, jalapeños, and tomatoes.

fah-384.title: Golden Nuggets Sandwiches
fah-384.culturalNotes: The nuggets can be frozen for up to a month. Serve the sandwiches with fries or chips.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts and thighs into small pieces.
instructions.2: Mix the salt, seasoned breadcrumbs, black pepper, red pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder with the diced chicken.
instructions.3: Mince the seasoned chicken well.
instructions.4: Add the flour, ready breadcrumbs, and dry breadcrumbs to the minced chicken and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the water quickly and stir until the mixture comes together.
instructions.6: Coat the chicken in the mixture and stir well.
instructions.7: Place the nuggets in an open freezer bag and cover them with a layer of dry breadcrumbs.
instructions.8: Store the nuggets in the freezer.
instructions.9: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.10: Fry the nuggets until golden.
instructions.11: Make the sauce by mixing the mayonnaise, ketchup, and honey.
instructions.12: Spread a little sauce on the lettuce and tomato slices.
instructions.13: Add the nuggets to the sandwiches and serve hot.

fah-385.title: Potato & Cheese Stuffed Sandwiches
fah-385.culturalNotes: Add pastrami to the filling if you like. The sandwiches keep in a lunchbox and can be served cold or warm.

instructions.1: Add 2½ cups of water to a pot over heat and bring to a boil.
instructions.2: Add a tablespoon of oil and a teaspoon of salt, then stir well.
instructions.3: Add 1½ cups of sifted flour and stir until the water is fully absorbed.
instructions.4: Let the dough cool slightly, then knead it by hand until smooth.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small balls the size of a lemon, making sure they're all equal.
instructions.6: Prepare the boiled potatoes, cut into small pieces, then add the shredded cheese, spices (salt, paprika, black pepper, chili, cumin), and parsley; mix well.
instructions.7: Take a ball of dough, flatten it on flour, fill it with the filling, and seal it well.
instructions.8: Repeat until all the balls are done.
instructions.9: Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the sandwiches on both sides until golden.
instructions.10: Let the sandwiches cool slightly before serving.

fah-386.title: Cheese & Smoked Rumi Pastry Roll Sandwiches
fah-386.culturalNotes: Add any other fillings you like such as sweet peppers or parsley. The sandwiches keep in the fridge for 2 days, or freeze them longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in the mixer bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, vinegar, and oil, and mix the dry ingredients together.
instructions.3: Add the warm milk gradually until you get a soft dough.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl and let it rise in a warm place until doubled.
instructions.6: After rising, roll the dough into a rectangle.
instructions.7: Spread the cream cheese over the dough, then add the cheddar slices and smoked Rumi.
instructions.8: Roll the dough tightly, then cut into equal pieces.
instructions.9: Place the pieces on an oiled or silicone-lined tray.
instructions.10: Prepare the mixture of Nescafe, sugar, milk powder, and water, and brush the sandwiches with it.
instructions.11: Sprinkle the sesame and nigella seeds over the sandwiches.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes, or until golden.
instructions.13: Serve the sandwiches hot with a cup of tea or your favorite drink.

fah-387.title: Quick Sandwiches for Club, Beach & School
fah-387.culturalNotes: Use any filling you prefer — cheese, pastrami, cooked chicken, olives, parsley. Freeze the sandwiches after cooling and serve when needed.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, vinegar, and oil; mix well.
instructions.3: Add the egg and mix again.
instructions.4: Add the warm milk gradually and knead until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.5: Knead the dough for 7–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30–60 minutes until doubled.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into small balls and flatten each to the desired thickness.
instructions.8: Place the filling in the center of each sandwich and seal tightly.
instructions.9: Place the sandwiches on an oiled tray, seam side down.
instructions.10: Let the sandwiches rise again for 10–15 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush the sandwiches with a mixture of milk powder, Nescafe, sugar, and water.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Remove the sandwiches from the oven and let them cool before serving.

fah-388.title: Stuffed Sandwiches — No Oven Needed
fah-388.culturalNotes: Freeze the stuffed sandwiches in freezer bags for later use. The fillings also work in other recipes like pizza and pastries.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the baking powder, yeast, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water gradually and mix until the dough comes together.
instructions.3: Add the oil halfway through kneading and mix well for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into small balls (about 20).
instructions.6: Flatten each ball, fill with your favorite filling, and close well.
instructions.7: Let the sandwiches rest briefly, then flatten them again.
instructions.8: Heat a pan over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.9: Fry the sandwiches until golden on both sides.
instructions.10: Cover the sandwiches while frying for better results.

fah-389.title: Molto-Style Sandwiches
fah-389.culturalNotes: Skip the sesame if you don't want it. These sandwiches are perfect for trips and the beach since they need no oven.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of milk and half a cup of warm water; mix well.
instructions.3: Add the water gradually until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Add a quarter cup of oil, mix well, then knead for 5 more minutes.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and leave it in a warm place until it rises.
instructions.7: Prepare the filling by mixing the Parmeli cheese, mozzarella, sweet pepper, and olives.
instructions.8: When the dough has risen, roll it out on a floured surface.
instructions.9: Take small pieces of dough and ball them up.
instructions.10: Flatten each ball, fill with the filling, and seal well.
instructions.11: Roll the sandwiches into an elongated shape.
instructions.12: Let the sandwiches rise again.
instructions.13: Heat the oil in a pan over high heat.
instructions.14: Dip the sandwiches in milk, then in sesame.
instructions.15: Fry the sandwiches until golden on both sides.
instructions.16: Drain the sandwiches on oil-absorbing paper.

fah-390.title: The School Sandwich
fah-390.culturalNotes: Use any filling you prefer based on what's in the fridge. Garnish with sesame, flax seeds, or nigella seeds. The sandwiches keep in a sealed plastic bag in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water, oil, warm milk, sugar, salt, and egg white in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yeast and mix well until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.3: Let the mixture sit for 10 minutes until foam appears on the surface.
instructions.4: Add the flour gradually and knead until you get a soft dough.
instructions.5: Let the dough rest for at least 7 minutes.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into 15 small balls.
instructions.7: Cover the balls with plastic to prevent drying.
instructions.8: Fill each ball with your favorite filling (cheese, olives, pepper, nigella seeds, thyme, parsley).
instructions.9: Flatten the dough and seal the edges well.
instructions.10: Let the sandwiches rise again.
instructions.11: Brush the sandwiches with a mixture of egg yolk, milk, sugar, and Nescafe.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Or fry the sandwiches in a pan over low heat, covered, until cooked through on all sides.

fah-391.title: Eastern Sujuk Sandwiches
fah-391.culturalNotes: Serve the sujuk with boiled pasta, peas, or white rice with browned potatoes and salad. The sujuk sauce also works as a side dip.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pan over heat.
instructions.2: Add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant.
instructions.3: Add the sujuk and stir with the garlic until it changes color.
instructions.4: Add the onion slices and stir until softened.
instructions.5: Add the peppers and tomatoes and stir with the sujuk and onion.
instructions.6: Add the ketchup, seven-spice, black pepper, and salt; stir into the mixture.
instructions.7: Add a pinch of sugar to taste.
instructions.8: Stir everything together, cover the pan, and leave over low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Add the pomegranate molasses and stir.
instructions.10: Turn off the heat and let the mixture cool slightly.
instructions.11: Serve the sujuk in sandwiches with baladi or fino bread as desired.

fah-392.title: Eggplant Strips
fah-392.culturalNotes: Serve the strips with ketchup or mayo-tomato cabbage dip. They also work in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Peel the eggplant and cut it into thick, long fingers.
instructions.2: Place the cut eggplant in a deep dish and season with salt and Knorr 11-spice; mix well.
instructions.3: Mix the flour, starch, salt, baking powder, and Knorr 11-spice in a bowl.
instructions.4: Divide the mixture in half: keep half dry, and add water gradually to the other half until it reaches a medium pancake-like consistency.
instructions.5: Dip the eggplant pieces in the dry mixture, then the wet mixture, then shake them in your hands to give them a craggy shape.
instructions.6: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the eggplant pieces until golden.
instructions.7: Drain the strips of excess oil using a colander.

fah-393.title: Street-Style Sujuk
fah-393.culturalNotes: Add some chopped parsley for garnish and flavor. Serve the sujuk with fries or a light salad.

instructions.1: Cut the peppers and onion into small pieces.
instructions.2: Cut the sujuk into small pieces.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the sujuk and stir until golden.
instructions.5: Add the onion and peppers and stir for 2–3 minutes until golden.
instructions.6: Add the minced garlic and tomatoes and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the salt and hot pepper and stir well.
instructions.8: Leave the mixture over heat for 5–7 minutes until done.
instructions.9: Serve the sujuk with tahini sauce in sandwiches.

fah-394.title: Smash Burgers
fah-394.culturalNotes: Adjust the ball size to match your buns. Add other ingredients like sweet peppers or parsley to taste.

instructions.1: Mix the ground meat with the fat and Knorr burger seasoning.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Shape the meat into equal balls (about 50 g each).
instructions.4: Refrigerate the balls to rest.
instructions.5: In a pan over heat, add 2 tablespoons of butter.
instructions.6: Add the minced onion and sauté until caramelized.
instructions.7: Add the sugar, salt, and black pepper; stir well.
instructions.8: Add the sliced mushrooms and stir until cooked.
instructions.9: Add the soy sauce and stir well.
instructions.10: In a bowl, mix the ketchup, mayonnaise, and mustard.
instructions.11: In a pan over heat, add a piece of butter.
instructions.12: Add a ball of meat and press it down hard to make it thin.
instructions.13: Flip until cooked on both sides, then place a cheese slice on top.
instructions.14: Toast the Kaiser bun in the pan.
instructions.15: Spread the sauce on the bun, then add the tomato, caramelized onion with mushrooms, and the burger with cheese.
instructions.16: Add jalapeños and pickles as desired.

fah-395.title: Crispy Potato Snacks
fah-395.culturalNotes: Use red potatoes for the best frying result. Try adding different flavors to the spice mix as desired.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into thin slices.
instructions.2: Add the ice water, vinegar, baking powder, and salt to a bowl and mix well.
instructions.3: Soak the potatoes in the solution for half an hour.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.5: Add the potatoes to the oil piece by piece to prevent sticking.
instructions.6: Stir the potatoes until golden and crispy.
instructions.7: Drain the potatoes on kitchen towels to absorb excess oil.
instructions.8: Mix the spices together in a bowl and store in an airtight jar.
instructions.9: Repeat steps 1–7 to make thin-sliced and spiral potatoes.
instructions.10: Serve the snacks with the mayonnaise-ketchup sauce.

fah-396.title: Waffle & Pancake Sandwiches
fah-396.culturalNotes: Serve the sandwiches with fresh fruits and vegetables for a balanced meal. They keep in a lunchbox and can be served cold.

instructions.1: For the pancakes: grease the sandwich maker with oil and pour in the pancake mix.
instructions.2: Close the machine and leave for 2–3 minutes until cooked.
instructions.3: Take out the pancakes and serve with fruits and honey or powdered sugar.
instructions.4: For the sandwiches: grease the iron with oil and add pancake batter.
instructions.5: Add the tomatoes, olives, turkey, and cheese.
instructions.6: Close the machine and leave for 2–3 minutes until cooked.
instructions.7: For bread sandwiches: spread labneh and the kids' favorite filling.
instructions.8: Fold the sandwiches and cut them in half.
instructions.9: Place skewers on the sandwiches and fill them.
instructions.10: For the hash potatoes: boil water and add the grated potatoes for 3 minutes.
instructions.11: Drain the potatoes and dry them well.
instructions.12: Add the spices, starch, and egg; mix well.
instructions.13: Place the potatoes in the sandwich maker and leave until cooked.

fah-397.title: Kofta Burger Sandwiches with Secret Marinade & Soft Bread
fah-397.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is cohesive and doesn't crack while kneading. Extra bread can be frozen for later use.

instructions.1: To prepare the burger buns:
instructions.2: Mix the flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the egg whites, vinegar, and yogurt; mix well.
instructions.4: Add the warm water gradually and knead the dough for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Add the butter-oil mixture and knead for 5 more minutes.
instructions.6: Place the dough in an oiled dish, cover, and let it rise for an hour.
instructions.7: To prepare the kofta burgers:
instructions.8: Chop the onion, red pepper, green pepper, and garlic in the food processor until smooth.
instructions.9: Add the burger seasoning, salt, black pepper, and ground meat; mix well.
instructions.10: Shape the kofta into patties and grill them on a tray over medium heat until cooked.
instructions.11: To prepare the caramelized onions:
instructions.12: Fry the onion in oil until golden.
instructions.13: Add the sugar, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper; stir until the onion is soft.
instructions.14: To shape the bread:
instructions.15: Cut the dough into balls the size of a large lemon.
instructions.16: Grease the baking sheet with oil, flatten each ball with soft butter, and shape into ovals.
instructions.17: Bake the loaves in a hot oven for 10 minutes.
instructions.19: Layer the sauce, special vegetables, kofta burger, caramelized onions, tomatoes, and cheese between the two halves of bread.

fah-398.title: Fluffy Sandwiches with Assorted Fillings
fah-398.culturalNotes: Use any fillings you like — seasoned meat, pizza toppings, or your favorite vegetables. Keep in the fridge for 2 days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water and buttermilk or yogurt and knead well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into small balls and cover them.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a floured surface until round and medium-thick.
instructions.7: Brush the surface with butter and fold in half.
instructions.8: Cover the dough again and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush the sandwiches with egg or cream and sprinkle with breadcrumbs if desired.
instructions.10: Brown the sandwiches in hot oil or bake in a hot oven until golden.
instructions.11: Let the sandwiches cool slightly, then serve with your favorite fillings.

fah-399.title: Magic Dough Sandwiches
fah-399.culturalNotes: Use any fillings you like — cooked meats or chopped vegetables. The dough keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in the warm water and set aside for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the flour, milk powder, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, and the yeast mixture to the flour and knead until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes or until doubled.
instructions.5: Divide the dough in two: use the first half in small pieces for sandwiches and the second for a large pizza.
instructions.6: Roll the dough for sandwiches into thin rounds and add your favorite fillings (cheese, chicken, peppers, tomatoes, olives).
instructions.7: Seal the sandwiches well and place on an oiled baking sheet.
instructions.8: Brush the sandwiches with milk mixed with sugar and salt, and sprinkle with nigella and sesame seeds.
instructions.9: Bake at high heat (about 200°C) for 15 minutes or until golden.

fah-400.title: Hurry-Up Tray (Kofta with Vegetables)
fah-400.culturalNotes: For a grilled flavor, place a hot coal in a small dish inside the covered tray for 10 minutes before serving.

instructions.1: Mix the ground meat with the minced onion, salt, pepper, seven-spice, and garlic.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture well until the meat fibers bind.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers as desired.
instructions.4: Toss the thinly sliced onion with salt, pepper, and cumin until wilted.
instructions.5: Place the onion in the baking tray, then add the carrots, potatoes, and colored peppers; mix well.
instructions.6: Arrange the kofta over the vegetables.
instructions.7: Add the tomato sauce and boiling water; mix well.
instructions.8: Cover the tray with foil and bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Lower the heat to 180°C and continue cooking until the kofta and vegetables are done.
instructions.10: Serve with white rice and salad.

fah-401.title: Vegetable & Chicken Tagine with Doum-Date Rice
fah-401.culturalNotes: Serve the tagine and rice with pickles and olives for a complete meal. Extend the cooking time for a more done dish.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes.
instructions.2: Slice the bell peppers, hot pepper, and tomatoes thinly.
instructions.3: Slice the garlic and red pepper.
instructions.4: Cut the onion into wedges.
instructions.5: Add the spices (Knorr potato seasoning, salt, cumin) to the onion and garlic and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the onion-garlic-spice mixture to the vegetables and toss well.
instructions.7: Wash the chicken, rinse it, and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.8: Add the chicken to the vegetable mixture and toss well.
instructions.9: Place the mixture in a tagine, add 3 tablespoons of oil and the red pepper, then add a cup of hot water and the Knorr sauce; mix well.
instructions.10: Bake the tagine in a hot oven until cooked.
instructions.11: Brown the vermicelli in 2 tablespoons of oil and a spoonful of ghee until golden.
instructions.12: Wash the rice, drain it, add it to the vermicelli, and mix well.
instructions.13: Add the salt and Knorr stock to the rice and mix well.
instructions.14: Add 4 cups of boiling water to the rice and mix well.
instructions.15: Cover the rice and leave over high heat until cooked, then keep covered over low heat.
instructions.16: Blend the doum juice, sugar, ground doum, milk, water, ice, and nuts until smooth.
instructions.17: Strain the juice and serve it cold.
instructions.18: Serve the tagine and rice hot with the juice.

fah-402.title: Happiness Sauce (Glazed Chicken Wings)
fah-402.culturalNotes: Use any chicken pieces you prefer. Marinate the chicken well for a distinctive flavor. The sauce keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the smoked paprika, onion powder, instant stock, black pepper, garlic powder, minced garlic, ketchup, lemon juice, vinegar, white honey, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients until combined.
instructions.3: Wash the chicken wings and open them with a sharp knife.
instructions.4: Coat the wings with the mixture on all sides, especially inside.
instructions.5: Refrigerate the wings for 2–3 hours to set.
instructions.6: Preheat the oven to high heat.
instructions.7: Place the wings on a rack in a tray with 2 cups of boiling water in the bottom.
instructions.8: Bake until the wings are roasted.
